newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Lebanon weekly CDs raise five bln pounds.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Lebanon weekly CDs raise five bln pounds.

text.p: The Bank of Lebanon issued on Thursday certificates of deposit dated November 22 to commercial banks worth five billion Lebanese pounds compared with seven billion last week.
The Bank sold 45-day CDs worth two billion pounds compared with four billion last week. It sold 60-day CDs worth three billion pounds, unchanged from last week.
Interest rates on the 45- and 60-day CDs were 12.25 percent and 13.00 percent respectively.
